simple.summary: בֻּנִּי (Bunnîy) means Bunni or Buni , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Neh 9 4.

definitions.full: H1138. Bunni בּוּנִּי proper name, masculine see בנה . בֻּנִּי proper name, masculine 1. Levites , a. Neh 9:4 , but read perhaps בִּנּוּי compare BeRy & see 10:10 ; 12:8 ; Ezra 8:33 ; b. בּוּנִּי ( בֶּן ) Neh 11:15 , but read perhaps בְּנֵי מִן etc. compare BeRy. 2 a chief of people Neh 10:16 , perhaps repetition of בָּנִי V:15 compare BeRy.
